extension.description: An IntelliJ IDEA-inspired Git workspace for Visual Studio Code.
configuration.title: JB Git
configuration.autoRefresh: Refresh repository state when files or Git metadata change.
configuration.confirmDiscard: Ask for confirmation before discarding changes.
configuration.protectedBranches: Branch-name patterns where force push is unavailable in Push Preview. Supports * and ?.
configuration.blame.showAuthor: Show the author in the Git Blame annotation column.
configuration.blame.showDate: Show the date in the Git Blame annotation column.
configuration.blame.showRevision: Show the abbreviated object ID in the Git Blame annotation column.
configuration.blame.dateFormat: Whether the Git Blame annotation shows the commit's own date or how long ago it was.
configuration.blame.maxAuthorWidth: Characters of the author name shown before the Git Blame annotation truncates it.
configuration.blame.heatMap: Tint each Git Blame annotation by how recent its commit is within the file.
configuration.blame.highlightCommit: Highlight every line the caret's commit touched while a file is annotated.
configuration.blame.ignoreWhitespace: Look through whitespace-only changes, so a reindent is not the last change to a line (git blame -w).
configuration.blame.detectMovementsWithi: Credit a block moved inside the file to where it came from (git blame -M).
configuration.blame.detectMovementsAcros: Also follow a block copied in from another file the same commit touched. Slower on a large history (git blame -C).
configuration.issueNavigation: Issue Navigation, as in IDEA: patterns that turn issue ids in commit messages into tracker links. Example: pattern "[A-Z]+-\\d+", url "https://youtrack.example.com/issue/$0".
configuration.issueNavigation.pattern: Regular expression that matches an issue id, e.g. [A-Z]+-\\d+.
configuration.issueNavigation.url: Link target; $0 is the whole match, $1-$9 are capture groups.
